faq.answer_zh:
**怀爱伦的著作数量庞大，初学者不必从第一页读起——稳妥的入门路线是「先读故事性强的，再读教义性的；先读与耶稣有关的，再读专题劝勉」。** 最常见的四条路径：

① 认识耶稣：《历代愿望》（The Desire of Ages）——全集中篇幅最大、最动人的一部，以耶稣生平为轴，字里行间充满对基督的敬爱，适合作为第一本；
② 理解大局：《善恶之争》（The Great Controversy）——从善恶之争的起源写到新天新地，帮你建立「历史与预言」的整体框架；
③ 个人灵修：《喜乐的密码》（Steps to Christ）——薄薄一册，专论亲近主、祷告与信心，最适合送给初信的亲友；
④ 教义与史传：接《先知与君王》《使徒行述》《福山宝训》等史传类著作，再按主题选读《教会证言》与《证言精选》。

阅读提醒：怀爱伦的著作被本会视为「预言恩赐」的印证，为教会带来安慰、指引与纠正，证实圣经真理，但绝不取代圣经——每一卷都当以圣经为衡量标准。上述书目中文世界均有通行中译本，建议从《历代愿望》或《喜乐的密码》开始。

faq.answer_zh:
**怀爱伦论述儿童教育的著作，集中在她关于「基督化教育」的系列作品里，最有代表性的有五部：**

① 《教育论》（Education，1903）——最系统的一部，提出「身体、智力、灵性均衡发展」的教育总纲，主张一切课程以圣经为中心、以服务人生为指向，反对单纯追逐分数与竞争；
② 《儿童教育指南》（Child Guidance，1954）——专论从幼儿到青少年的养育与教导，从学龄前的日常引导讲到青春期，被许多父母当作实务手册逐章对照；
③ 《给父母、教师和学生的劝勉》（Counsels to Parents, Teachers, and Students，1928）——按主题汇编的劝勉，涵盖家庭教导、学校选择、功课负担、安息日与游戏等具体场景；
④ 《论家庭》（The Adventist Home，1952）——把家庭教育置于信仰的核心，论父母的以身作则、家庭礼拜的建立与家规的执行；
⑤ 《基督教教育基础》（Fundamentals of Christian Education，1923）——论述为何必须建立不随从世界潮流的基督化学校，是理解本会教育立场的钥匙。

贯穿这些著作的核心主张是：教育不只是知识的灌输，更是品格的塑造；家庭是孩子的第一所学校，父母是孩子的第一任老师——「教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离」（箴22:6），任何脱离信仰的教育都是残缺的。若你只能先读一本，建议从《儿童教育指南》开始——它最贴近日常养育。

温馨提示：怀爱伦的著作被本会视为「预言恩赐」的印证，为教会带来安慰、指引与纠正，证实圣经真理，但绝不取代圣经；这些原则性教导也不替代你在具体处境中的祷告与牧者咨询。

faq.answer_zh:
**幼儿奉献礼（儿童奉献礼）不是「婴孩得救」的仪式，而是父母当众立约的典礼——把孩子重新献给神，并请求教会与他们一同把这孩子抚养成人。** 这一做法最古老的榜样是哈拿：她曾在耶和华面前许愿，若蒙赐予儿子，就将他献给神（撒上1:11）；圣经也说「儿女是耶和华所赐的产业，所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐」（诗127:3）。

典礼通常这样进行：牧师当众询问父母——是否立志照着主的教训养育这孩子、以身作则带领他认识主，父母应「是」；会众则承诺以祷告与团契相助。之后牧师为孩子祝福祷告。

有两点请留意：其一，得救在于孩子自己将来对福音的回应，父母不能代替；其二，奉献礼之后，日常的家庭礼拜与身教才是「还愿」的真正内容——弗6:4 吩咐「照着主的教训和警戒养育他们」。

faq.answer_zh:
**管教的真义是「训练」而非「发怒」——目标是孩子的品格与幸福，不是父母的体面。** 怀爱伦一面责备溺爱：「有些好安逸、怕麻烦的父母，不敢对他们桀骜不驯的儿子施行健康的权威，怕他们离家出走。孩子走了反而比留下败家好得多」（CG 241.1）；一面警告失职：「那些没有训练儿女敬畏神、任凭他们长成的父母有祸了」（CG 275.1）。

她的方法是平衡的：「引导孩子的发展而不以过度的控制阻碍他，是父母和教师都当学的功课。管理太多与管理太少同样有害。妄想『折断孩子的意志』是危险的错误」（Ed 288.1）。可操作的原则：规则少而清晰、执行一致而温和、怒火上来时先祷告再开口。

citations.snippet: Take Extreme Steps if Willful Disobedience Is Unchecked —Some indulgent, ease-loving parents fear to exercise wholesome authority over their unruly sons, lest they run away from home. It would be better for some to do this than to remain at home to live upon the bounties provided by the parents, and at the same time trample upon all authority, both human and divine.

Faulty Training Affects Entire Religious Life —A woe rests upon parents who have not trained their children to be God-fearing, but have allowed them to grow to manhood and womanhood undisciplined and uncontrolled. During their own childhood they were allowed to manifest passion and willfulness and to act from impulse, and they bring this same spirit into their own homes. They are defective in temper, and passionate in government.

To direct the child’s development without hindering it by undue control should be the study of both parent and teacher. Too much management is as bad as too little. The effort to “break the will” of a child is a terrible mistake. Minds are constituted differently; while force may secure outward submission, the result with many children is a more determined rebellion of the heart.
And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord

faq.answer_zh:
**年轻时就把心交给神，是能祝福一生也祝福永恒的抉择——怀爱伦在《青年导言》里专门劝青年人趁早委身。** 她写道：「有人听道，确信自己一向与基督相违；他们知罪，为过犯悔改，倚靠基督的功劳，就因信得了义」（MYP 73.3）。对青年的本分，她的视野是责任：「当按个人的需要唤醒他们的责任感」（Ed 279.3）。

给青年的三个建议：① 现在就认真想「我为谁而活」——这个问题越早面对越少走弯路；② 找一位可信的属灵长辈同行；③ 把每天的读经祷告当作属灵账户的定投。父母能做的最好一件事，是为儿女的生命持续祷告，并活出值得效法的样子。

citations.snippet: There are those who listen to the truth, and are convinced that they have been living in opposition to Christ. They are condemned, and they repent of their transgressions. Relying upon the merits of Christ, exercising true faith in Him, they receive pardon for sin. As they cease to do evil and learn to do well, they grow in grace and in the knowledge of God.

The children and youth under the teacher’s care differ widely in disposition, habits, and training. Some have no definite purpose or fixed principles. They need to be awakened to their responsibilities and possibilities. Few children have been rightly trained at home. Some have been household pets. Their whole training has been superficial.
Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it

faq.answer_zh:
**照顾病人是爱心最具体的考场：诚实、清洁、适度、陪伴，四件事都不可少。** 怀爱伦论医者的坦诚：「与病人坦诚相交，能激发他的信心，是康复的重要助力」（MH 245.2）；论健康习惯：「凡是健康的人，都当注重沐浴，一周沐浴两次也好；不健康的人血液里有杂质，皮肤也失去健康状态」（CH 104.1）；她也教人把原理讲给孩子：「父母啊，要教导儿女从因及果地推理，明白身体的法则」（CH 429.1）。

照顾者可做的清单：环境清洁通风、温水擦浴、易消化的清淡饮食、准时的药与休息、以及最重要的——耐心的陪伴与祷告。涉及治疗决策，请遵医嘱；这里是照护的原则，不是医疗方案。

citations.snippet: Frankness in dealing with a patient inspires him with confidence, and thus proves an important aid to recovery. There are physicians who consider it wise policy to conceal from the patient the nature and cause of the disease from which he is suffering. Many, fearing to excite or discourage a patient by stating the truth, will hold out false hopes of recovery, and even allow a patient to go down to the grave without warning him of his danger.

Persons in health should on no account neglect bathing. They should by all means bathe as often as twice a week. Those who are not in health have impurities in the blood, and the skin is not in a healthy condition. The multitude of pores, or little mouths, through which the body breathes, become clogged and filled with waste matter.

If all would obtain a knowledge of this subject and would feel the importance of putting it to practical use, we should see a better condition of things. Parents, teach your children to reason from cause to effect. Show them that, if they violate the laws of health, they must pay the penalty by suffering. Show them that recklessness in regard to bodily health tends to recklessness in morals. Your children require patient, faithful care.
let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him

faq.answer_zh:
**丧亲的痛是真实的，但基督徒的哀恸有盼望托底——所爱之人只是睡了，复活的清晨必再相见。** 怀爱伦用基督的同在安慰丧亲者：「那位在寡妇独子被抬往安葬时把他还给她的主，今日仍体恤丧亲母亲的哀伤；在拉撒路坟前洒下同情之泪、把马利亚和马大的兄弟还给她们的祂……至今仍记得祂的母亲」（AH 204.2）。她也让我们看见复活的大能：「拉撒路是基督最坚定的门徒之一……救主祝福一切寻求祂帮助的人，祂爱祂所救的人」（DA 524.1）。

哀伤不需要「加油振作」，需要「允许悲伤」：找人陪、痛快哭、把回忆交托给神。必要时，寻求专业心理支持与教会的陪伴，都是智慧之举。

From their first meeting his faith in Christ had been strong; his love for Him was deep, and he was greatly beloved by the Saviour. It was for Lazarus that the greatest of Christ’s miracles was performed. The Saviour blessed all who sought His help; He loves all the human family, but to some He is bound by peculiarly tender associations.

faq.answer_zh:
**洗礼是公开的见证与顺服的行动：表明与基督同死、同埋葬、同复活，不是得救的「条件」，而是得救后的「宣告」。** 基督亲自立下榜样：约翰想要拦住祂，「耶稣回答说：『你暂且许我，因为我们理当这样尽诸般的义。』约翰就允了，领救主下约旦河，把祂浸在水里」（DA 111.1）。

因此洗礼至少表达三层意思：① 归属——从此公开作基督的门徒；② 罪得赦免的良心——借着水表明洗净；③ 生命的转折——旧人死去，新人兴起。它不能「换来」救恩，却是一个人信心真实的记号。想进一步明白，可与教会牧者细谈。

citations.snippet: As Jesus asked for baptism, John drew back, exclaiming, “I have need to be baptized of Thee, and comest Thou to me?” With firm yet gentle authority, Jesus answered, “Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfill all righteousness.” And John, yielding, led the Saviour down into the Jordan, and buried Him beneath the water.

faq.answer_zh:
**圣经的宣告明确而有能力：世界是神在六日内创造、第七日安息的——这是历史事件，也是信仰根基。** 怀爱伦写道：「像安息日一样，一周也源于创造，并借着圣经历史保存至今。上帝亲自量出第一周，作为后继各周直到时间末了的样本。六日用于创造之工，第七日祂休息了」（CE 190.1）。

她把这日与创造、救赎连在一起：「当晨星一同歌唱、神的众子一同欢呼时，安息日被赐给世界，使人永远记住六日之内神创造了世界」（CH 357.3）。面对进化论，基督徒的立场是：科学观察与圣经不必然冲突，但「人从偶然物质中来」与「人按神形象被造」是两种世界观——后者才给人真正的尊严与目的。

citations.snippet: Like the Sabbath, the week originated at creation, and it has been preserved and brought down to us through Bible history. God himself measured off the first week as a sample for successive weeks to the close of time. Like every other, it consisted of seven literal days. Six days were employed in the work of creation; upon the seventh, God rested, and he then blessed this day, and set it apart as a day of rest for man.

When the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy, the Sabbath was given to the world, that man might ever remember that in six days God created the world. He rested upon the seventh day, blessing it as the day of His rest, and gave it to the beings He had created, that they might remember Him as the true and living God.
And on the seventh day God ended his work ... and he rested

faq.answer_zh:
**圣经不给恶以「本体」，却指明它的来源：罪起于一个受造之物的自求——路锡甫想要神的座位。** 怀爱伦的描述：「在天上这律就被破坏了。罪起源于自求。路锡甫，那遮掩基路伯，想要在天上居首。他想要控制天上的生灵，把他们从造他们的主那里夺过来，赢得他们对他的尊崇。因此他亵渎神，把自高的欲望归给祂」（DA 21.3）。反叛的结局是被逐：「路锡甫在天上想要权柄第一，想要作神，统治天庭；为达此目的，他赢得了许多天使。当他与叛逆的群伙被逐出天庭之后，叛逆与自求的工作就在地上延续」（CT 32.3）。

这就是「善恶之争」的序幕：不是神与魔两股「平衡力量」的永恒对峙，而是受造物对造物主的悖逆，以及神在基督里最终、已定的得胜。

citations.snippet: In heaven itself this law was broken. Sin originated in self-seeking. Lucifer, the covering cherub, desired to be first in heaven. He sought to gain control of heavenly beings, to draw them away from their Creator, and to win their homage to himself. Therefore he misrepresented God, attributing to Him the desire for self-exaltation. With his own evil characteristics he sought to invest the loving Creator. Thus he deceived angels. faq.answer_zh:
**十诫没有被恩典「废掉」——律法显明神品格与人的罪，恩典赐下遵行的能力与赦免，二者从不对立。** 怀爱伦论到那些接受「基督中保之工与神律法永久性」真理的人：「这些就是启示录第十四章所提出的真理」（GC 435.2）；论基督与律法，「安息日不仅为以色列设立，乃是为世界。它在伊甸就已指示人，与十诫其他各条一样，都有永不废弛的义务」（DA 283.2）。

因此守律法不是「赚救恩」的方式（从来没有人能靠行为称义），而是「感恩的回应」：已被拯救的人，自然愿意行在赐律法者的道路上。保罗说得最准：律法是训蒙的师傅，引我们到基督那里，使我们因信称义（加3:24）。

citations.snippet: Those who had accepted the light concerning the mediation of Christ and the perpetuity of the law of God found that these were the truths presented in Revelation 14 . The messages of this chapter constitute a threefold warning (see Appendix ) which is to prepare the inhabitants of the earth for the Lord’s second coming. The announcement, “The hour of His judgment is come,” points to the closing work of Christ’s ministration for the salvation of men.

The Sabbath was not for Israel merely, but for the world. It had been made known to man in Eden, and, like the other precepts of the Decalogue, it is of imperishable obligation. Of that law of which the fourth commandment forms a part, Christ declares, “Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in nowise pass from the law.” So long as the heavens and the earth endure, the Sabbath will continue as a sign of the Creator’s power.
I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil

faq.answer_zh:
**圣经（尤其启示录与但以理书）预言末后有一场对神子民的最后考验——「雅各遭难的时候」是其中最严肃的一幕。** 怀爱伦写道：「神的子民那时要陷入先知所形容的雅各遭难受苦之境」（GC 616.1）；而安息日将成为忠心的焦点：「安息日将是忠诚的大试验，因为它正是被特别争论的真理要点。当最后的考验临到世人时，事奉神与不事奉神之间的界线就划出来了」（GC 605.2）。

她的焦点始终不是「猜日期」而是「预备品格」：「神的眼目看顾着祂子民要面对的危机……祂的膀臂必遮蔽他们」（GC 634.1）。给我们的功课：不妄测时辰，但认真预备——与神的关系，是任何考验中唯一的保障。

All faces are turned into paleness. Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.” Jeremiah 30:5-7 .

The Sabbath will be the great test of loyalty, for it is the point of truth especially controverted. When the final test shall be brought to bear upon men, then the line of distinction will be drawn between those who serve God and those who serve Him not.

The eye of God, looking down the ages, was fixed upon the crisis which His people are to meet, when earthly powers shall be arrayed against them. Like the captive exile, they will be in fear of death by starvation or by violence. But the Holy One who divided the Red Sea before Israel, will manifest His mighty power and turn their captivity.

faq.answer_zh:
**圣经应许的终点不是虚无的「天堂」，而是神同在中的新天新地——复活的身体、恢复的伊甸、没有眼泪的城。** 怀爱伦的描写带着家庭的温暖：「在重新造的地上，得赎的人要从事那些在起初曾给亚当夏娃带来喜乐的工作与娱乐。伊甸的生活要在这里继续，在园圃与田间的生活」（AH 549.1）；新耶路撒冷的景象：「我又看见一个新天新地……圣城新耶路撒冷由神那里从天而降，预备好了，就如新妇妆饰整齐，等候丈夫」（Ed 301.4）。

这应许抚平今生最大的恐惧：「神要擦去他们一切的眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛」（启21:4）。今日的忍耐因此有方向，离别因此有重逢。

citations.snippet: Occupations in the New Earth —In the earth made new the redeemed will engage in the occupations and pleasures that brought happiness to Adam and Eve in the beginning. The Eden life will be lived, the life in garden and field. “They shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

“I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away.... And I John saw the Holy City, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.” Revelation 21:1, 2 .

faq.answer_zh:
**圣经里的基督不是高高在上的教主，而是「带着君王尊严、心里柔和谦卑」的同行者——祂所到之处都成为祝福。** 怀爱伦写道：「我们的救赎主在地上行走时，带着君王的尊严；然而祂心里柔和谦卑。祂无论到哪里，都是光与祝福，因为祂把喜乐、盼望和勇气带在身边」（AH 156.1）。

祂的吸引不靠奢华：「耶稣不用满足人对奢侈的欲望来吸引人。对那又困又饿的大众，简单的饮食不仅是祂能力的保证，也是祂对日常需要温柔眷顾的凭证。救主没有应许门徒世界的奢华」（DA 367.2）。学基督，就从三件事开始：对人温和（不轻易发怒）、对物简朴（不炫耀比较）、对己诚实（不戴面具）。

faq.answer_zh:
**苦难不是神缺席的证据，往往是祂精炼的工作——圣经从应许「蒙试验的信心比金子更显宝贵」。** 怀爱伦论那些为良心自由受苦的人：「正是对良心自由的渴望，激励天路客冒渡海之险，忍受旷野的艰难危险」（GC 292.3）——苦难从来不白受，它锻造品格、扩散福音。圣经也应许：「忍受试探的人是有福的，因为他经过试验以后，必得生命的冠冕」（雅1:12）。

还有一句让一切苦难归位的经文：「我们晓得万事都互相效力，叫爱神的人得益处」（罗8:28）。这不是说苦难本身是好的，而是说神能使它产出好的。若你正在深谷里，请允许自己求助：牧者、专业心理咨询、可信的朋友——约拿在鱼腹中祷告，神仍垂听。

citations.snippet: It was the desire for liberty of conscience that inspired the Pilgrims to brave the perils of the long journey across the sea, to endure the hardships and dangers of the wilderness, and with God’s blessing to lay, on the shores of America, the foundation of a mighty nation. faq.answer_zh:
**神的带领是真实的，且祂乐于引导——问题是人常想先看完整地图，才决定要不要上路。** 怀爱伦写道：「天上的使者注视着地上神家的困苦，他们准备与人合作，减轻压迫与苦难。神在祂的护理中安排了环境」（DA 500.1）；对于今生想不通的事，她指向永恒的视角：「凡在神的护理中令我们困惑的，在来生都要显明。难以明白的事将得到解释，恩典的奥秘要在我们面前展开」（AH 542.2）。

寻求引导的实在步骤：① 圣经的原则先立定（不与真理冲突）；② 祷告中交托而非审问；③ 智慧人的商议；④ 环境开路的印证。最可靠的凭据不是「感觉」，而是「祂的话」——诗篇119:105说，你的话是我脚前的灯。

citations.snippet: The angels of heaven look upon the distress of God’s family upon the earth, and they are prepared to co-operate with men in relieving oppression and suffering. God in His providence had brought the priest and the Levite along the road where the wounded sufferer lay, that they might see his need of mercy and help. There are homes for the pilgrims of earth. There are robes for the righteous, with crowns of glory and palms of victory. All that has perplexed us in the providences of God will in the world to come be made plain. The things hard to be understood will then find explanation. The mysteries of grace will unfold before us. Where our finite minds discovered only confusion and broken promises, we shall see the most perfect and beautiful harmony.
all things work together for good to them that love God

faq.answer_zh:
**圣经明确禁止与「死人」交通——所谓亡者显灵、托梦相会，圣经说那不是你所爱的人，而是欺骗的灵。** 怀爱伦直接指出：「此外，神已明文禁止一切所谓与亡魂 pretended 的交往。希伯来时代有一等人，像今天的招魂术士一样自称能与死人通问。但圣经宣告这些『交鬼的』是鬼魔的工作」（GC 556.2）；她更预言末后最大的骗局：「撒旦亲自冒充基督，作为这大欺骗戏的高潮」（GC 624.2）。

以赛亚的警告至今有效：「有人对你们说：『当求问那些交鬼的和行巫术的……』百姓不当求问自己的神吗？……他们所说的若不与此相符，只因他们没有光」（赛8:19-20）。失去亲人的痛值得被温柔承接——但承接的方式是祷告与圣经的盼望，不是打开灵交的门。

citations.snippet: Furthermore, God has expressly forbidden all pretended communication with departed spirits. In the days of the Hebrews there was a class of people who claimed, as do the spiritualists of today, to hold communication with the dead. But the “familiar spirits,” as these visitants from other worlds were called, are declared by the Bible to be “the spirits of devils.”

As the crowning act in the great drama of deception, Satan himself will personate Christ. The church has long professed to look to the Saviour’s advent as the consummation of her hopes. Now the great deceiver will make it appear that Christ has come. In different parts of the earth, Satan will manifest himself among men as a majestic being of dazzling brightness, resembling the description of the Son of God given by John in the Revelation.

Says the prophet Isaiah: “When they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead? To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.” Isaiah 8:19, 20 .
To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.

faq.answer_zh:
**工作不是堕落之后的「咒诅附加品」，而是人在伊甸就领受的使命——耕耘与守护本身就是敬拜。** 怀爱伦的教育观里，劳动是品格的一部分：「每个青年都当学习实际生活的职责，各人要获得一门手工劳作的知识，必要时可以借此谋生。这不仅为应对人生变迁的保障，也对身体、心智和灵性都有益」（CE 69.1）。她也看到劳动的防护作用：「学校若提供手工劳动的机会，使学生以部分时间从事有用的作业，就能防护许多弥漫在学府中的恶影响」（CE 44.1）。

因此无论什么岗位：① 尽力做好——作什么事都像给主作（西3:23）；② 保持诚实——不占不贪；③ 记住身份——你是神的儿女暂任此职，不是职位定义你。

citations.snippet: And now, as in the days of Israel, every youth should be instructed in the duties of practical life. Each should acquire a knowledge of some branch of manual labor, by which, if need be, he may obtain a livelihood. This is essential, not only as a safeguard against the vicissitudes of life, but from its bearing upon physical, mental, and moral development.

If facilities for manual labor were provided in connection with our school, and students were required to devote a portion of their time to some active employment, it would prove a safeguard against many of the evil influences that prevail in institutions of learning.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men

faq.answer_zh:
**基督徒的服饰原则是「端庄朴素」——衣着的目的是合体与遮护，不是炫耀与比较。** 怀爱伦把服饰与信仰的见证连在一起：「我们若穿朴素端庄的服装，不随波逐流的时尚；餐桌常备简单健康的饮食，避免奢侈浪费；房屋建造陈设皆有度——这就显明了真理有使人成圣的能力」（CD 90.2）；她也劝人免于邻舍比较的捆绑：「不要装作富有，或超过我们本分的样子——作卑微、跟随柔和谦卑救主的人。邻舍怎样建造装饰房屋，我们不必心有不平」（AH 384.2）。

可用的判断标准：这件衣服会不会引人注目到成为崇拜的对象？价格是否在挥霍？穿它的动机是荣耀神，还是讨好眼球？端庄之外，她也提醒母亲：「为孩子衣着花费过度之前，先算算永恒的价值」——朴素不是寒酸，是自由。

citations.ref: Counsels on Diet and Foods, p. 90.2 (CD 90.2)
citations.snippet: Should we dress in plain, modest apparel without reference to the fashions; should our tables at all times be set with simple, healthful food, avoiding all luxuries, all extravagance; should our houses be built with becoming plainness, and furnished in the same manner, it would show the sanctifying power of the truth, and would have a telling influence upon unbelievers.

Do Not Emulate Fashionable Neighbors —It is not best to pretend to be rich, or anything above what we are—humble followers of the meek and lowly Saviour. We are not to feel disturbed if our neighbors build and furnish their houses in a manner that we are not authorized to follow. How must Jesus look upon our selfish provision for the indulgence of appetite, to please our guests, or to gratify our own inclination!

faq.answer_zh:
**娱乐的界限不在「活动本身」，而在「它把我的心带向哪里」——怀爱伦给的检验标准非常实用：能否奉主的名去做。** 她说：「真正的基督徒不会想进入任何娱乐场所、从事任何他不愿求神祝福的消遣。他不会出现在戏院、弹子房或保龄球场，不与跳舞的人相合，不沉溺任何会使基督离开心中的迷人乐趣」（AH 515.4）。她更直言某些场所的性质：「戏院是道德最危险的所在。它被称为美德学校，实为不道德的温床。恶习与罪性因这些娱乐而加强巩固」（AH 516.2）。

给现代人的应用：① 内容检验——这部片子我在基督里敢不敢看完？② 时间检验——它吞掉的是我该给家人、读经、睡眠的时间吗？③ 影响检验——看完我是更烦躁还是更安宁？合宜的娱乐是礼物，越界的娱乐是陷阱。

citations.snippet: The true Christian will not desire to enter any place of amusement or engage in any diversion upon which he cannot ask the blessing of God. He will not be found at the theater, the billiard hall, or the bowling saloon. He will not unite with the gay waltzers or indulge in any other bewitching pleasure that will banish Christ from the mind.

The Theater the Hotbed of Immorality —Among the most dangerous resorts for pleasure is the theater. Instead of being a school for morality and virtue, as is so often claimed, it is the very hotbed of immorality. Vicious habits and sinful propensities are strengthened and confirmed by these entertainments. Low songs, lewd gestures, expressions, and attitudes deprave the imagination and debase the morals.
Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

faq.answer_zh:
**怜悯不是可有可无的「额外善行」，而是信心的活证据——怀爱伦把它与「真实的宗教」划等号。** 她劝人把行善做实、做小、做不张扬：「让我们想想能为主哪些穷人做什么，可以救助哪一位寡妇、孤儿、贫穷的家庭——不作大张旗鼓的宣扬，只作神恩典流通的管道」（AH 474.4）；她也把怜悯与基督的门徒身份绑定：「我们救主的温柔同情为堕落受苦的人类被激动了。你若作祂的门徒，就必须培养怜悯与同情。对人间疾苦的冷漠必须让位于对他人痛苦的关心。寡妇、孤儿、病人与临终者，永远需要帮助」（CH 34.2）。

今日可做的一件小事：想起一个具体的人（不是抽象的「穷人」），在本周内为他做一件具体的事。行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与神同行（弥6:8）。

citations.snippet: Now a season is coming when we shall have our principles tested. Let us begin to think what we can do for God’s needy ones. We can make them through ourselves the recipients of God’s blessings. Think what widow, what orphan, what poor family you can relieve, not in a way to make a great parade about the matter, but be as a channel through which the Lord’s substance shall flow as a blessing to His poor....

The tender sympathies of our Saviour were aroused for fallen and suffering humanity. If you would be His followers, you must cultivate compassion and sympathy. Indifference to human woes must give place to lively interest in the sufferings of others. The widow, the orphan, the sick and the dying, will always need help. Here is an opportunity to proclaim the gospel—to hold up Jesus, the hope and consolation of all men.
He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

faq.answer_zh:
**「基督的心就是宣教的心」——每一个重生的人，心里都会自然涌出让别人也认识祂的冲动。** 怀爱伦写道：「基督的精神就是宣教的精神。重生之人最初的冲动，就是领别人也到救主面前」（GC 70.2）；她看孩子也能参与：「我们的教会学校是神所设立的，为要预备孩童承担这大工。孩童可以参加医疗布道工作，用他们微小的力量帮助有病和受苦的人」（AH 489.4）。

参与的四种方式（不必都远行）：① 去——短期或长期的参与；② 献——十分之一以外的乐意捐支持工人；③ 祷——为未得之民提名祷告；④ 迎——接待远方的弟兄、与身边的留学生和外籍朋友分享。宣教的起点不是资格，是一颗被基督的爱推动的心。

citations.snippet: The spirit of Christ is a missionary spirit. The very first impulse of the renewed heart is to bring others also to the Saviour. Such was the spirit of the Vaudois Christians.

Our church schools are ordained by God to prepare the children for this great work. Here children are to be instructed in the special truths for this time and in practical missionary work. They are to enlist in the army of workers to help the sick and the suffering. Children can take part in the medical missionary work and by their jots and tittles can help to carry it forward....
Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them

faq.answer_zh:
**感恩不是境遇顺遂时的「情绪附加品」，而是一种可以选择、需要操练的生命姿态——它直接决定心的天气。** 怀爱伦说：「患难可能侵入，但这是人类的命运。让忍耐、感恩与爱使心中常有阳光，即使天色再阴霾」（AH 18.1）；她也指出不知足的病灶：「你没有知足的元素。你反复思想自己的难处；想象中的缺乏与穷乏在眼前虎视眈眈……你不培养对神的爱和感恩的心，数算慈爱的天父所赐的一切福气」（AH 112.1）。

两个练习：① 每天睡前写下三件具体的恩典（越具体越难被忽略）；② 把「我没有」换成「我还有」——知足不是拥有多，是珍惜所有。「耶和华是我的牧者，我必不至缺乏」（诗23:1）。

citations.snippet: Troubles may invade, but these are the lot of humanity. Let patience, gratitude, and love keep sunshine in the heart though the day may be ever so cloudy. 11 The Ministry of Healing, 393 .

You have not the elements of a contented spirit. You dwell upon your troubles; imaginary want and poverty far ahead stare you in the face; you feel afflicted, distressed, agonized; your brain seems on fire, your spirits depressed. You do not cherish love to God and gratitude of heart for all the blessings which your kind heavenly Father has bestowed upon you. You see only the discomforts of life.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

faq.answer_zh:
**谦卑不是看轻自己，是准确地看自己——知道一切所有皆受之于神，因此能放下「我比别人强」的幻觉。** 基督亲自示范：「我心里柔和谦卑，你们当负我的轭，学我的样式，这样，你们心里就必得享安息」（太11:29）——注意顺序：先学样式，后得安息。怀爱伦劝基督徒随身携带这香气：「基督徒无论往哪里，都当散发基督义行的甜美芬芳，表明他们顺从了邀请：『学我的样式，因为我心里柔和谦卑』」（CH 355.3）。

在家中的操练：「母亲们啊，你们若顺从不耐烦、严厉待儿女，你们就不是学基督，而是学另一个夫子。耶稣说：『我心里柔和谦卑』」（CG 267.3）。骄傲的解毒剂只有一样：定睛看基督——看得够清楚，就会像以赛亚在殿中一样说「祸哉我灭亡了」，也像彼得一样说「主啊，离开我」。

citations.snippet: Christians should carry with them, wherever they go, the sweet fragrance of Christ’s righteousness, showing that they are complying with the invitation, “Learn of Me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.” Matthew 11:29, 30 .

Mothers, when you yield to impatience and deal harshly with your children, you are not learning of Christ, but of another master. Jesus says, “Take my yoke upon you and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart; and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest

faq.answer_zh:
**怀爱伦关于家庭最系统的著述是《复临信徒的家庭》（The Adventist Home）；此外《教会证言》卷六、卷七有大量家庭实务劝导，《教育论》与《给家长和教师的证言》专论儿女教养，《先祖与先知》则以族长家庭为典范。** 在她眼中，家庭是神所设立的第一所学校：「主本着祂的智慧命定，家庭要成为一切教育机构中最伟大的一所」（AH 182.2）；「每一个家庭的四周都有上帝划定的神圣范围，应当予以保持」（AH 177.1）。

① 《复临信徒的家庭》——家庭生活总论：婚姻的选择与预备（AH 43.1）、夫妇相处、教养原则、家庭敬拜，是最该先读的一部；
② 《教会证言》卷六、卷七——大量针对具体家庭的实务劝导与劝勉；
③ 《教育论》《给家长和教师的证言》——儿女教育与「第一本教科书」；
④ 《先祖与先知》——亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各等族长家庭的信心榜样。

圣经同样把家庭放在信仰传承的中心：「我所吩咐你的话都要记在心上，也要殷勤教训你的儿女」（申 6:6-7）；「你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，只要照着主的教训和警戒养育他们」（弗 6:4）。

建议的读法：先从《复临信徒的家庭》通读一遍，再按需要查《教会证言》中相关的书信段落——她的家庭劝勉从来不是抽象原则，而是落到日常相处的实处。

citations.snippet: The Family Circle a School —In His wisdom the Lord has decreed that the family shall be the greatest of all educational agencies. It is in the home that the education of the child is to begin. Here is his first school. Here, with his parents as instructors, he is to learn the lessons that are to guide him throughout life—lessons of respect, obedience, reverence, self-control. The educational influences of the home are a decided power for good or for evil.

Sanctity of the Family Circle —There is a sacred circle around every family which should be preserved. No other one has any right in that sacred circle. The husband and wife should be all to each other. The wife should have no secrets to keep from her husband and let others know, and the husband should have no secrets to keep from his wife to relate to others.

A Happy or Unhappy Marriage? —If those who are contemplating marriage would not have miserable, unhappy reflections after marriage, they must make it a subject of serious, earnest reflection now. This step taken unwisely is one of the most effective means of ruining the usefulness of young men and women. Life becomes a burden, a curse.

And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house
